license_references.LicenseRef-psport-separate-work: psport is a separate project under GPL-2.0-only, built or downloaded by decanter at run time and run as its own process. It is not linked into decanter and no psport source or binary is distributed in a decanter release.
license_references.LicenseRef-Cargo-Dependencies: Third-party Rust crates declare their own SPDX expressions in their Cargo.toml. scripts/licenses.py inventories them from cargo metadata and refuses an expression that has no alternative on its allow-list.
license_references.LicenseRef-raven-separate-work: Raven (https://github.com/mirkobrombin/raven) is a separate project under GPL-3.0-or-later, cloned at a pinned commit and built on the user's machine only when they ask for it in the Raven section, and run as its own process. It is not linked into decanter and no Raven source or binary is distributed in a decanter release.
license_references.LicenseRef-game-patch-authors: crates/ps/data/bloodborne/Bloodborne.xml carries patches whose authors are named in their Author attributes: Kyo, auser1337, Lance McDonald (manfightdragon), illusion, emoose, Dasaav, Foxy Hooligans, Imedved, Whitehawkx, bloo, stagvant, yogesh1239 and bbport. No licence is stated for them; each author keeps their rights, and the file is redistributed as it is with their names (owner decision, kb #1131).

components.name: decanter application, libraries and build tooling
components.provenance: LICENSE. The GOG web API client in crates/gog/src/api began as gog 0.5.0 (gogapi-rs) by nicohman (GPL-3.0-only); none of its code remains: its files were removed and the last four derived ones rewritten clean-room from docs/gog-api-behaviour-spec.md (kb #1228, decision #1225), see crates/gog/src/api/VENDOR.md. Until then the binaries were distributed under GPL-3.0-only terms (kb #1073); they can now be offered under GPL-3.0-or-later. crates/gog/src/cloud_saves.rs, once a port of heroic-gogdl (GPL-3, no "or later" notice, kb #1530), was rewritten clean-room from docs/gog-cloud-saves-behaviour-spec.md (kb #1525): the specification was written by a different agent than the implementer, and the implementer did not read heroic-gogdl, the previous file or its history. Until then the binaries that linked it, v0.4.0 among them, carried GPL-3.0-only terms for the combined work.

components.name: decanter documentation and screenshots
components.provenance: Written for this repository. The screenshots in docs/screenshots show the application and may show cover art of games the owner has: confirm they carry nothing that is not ours before a release ships them.

components.name: Galaxy64.dll achievement proxy
components.provenance: crates/hook/Cargo.toml. A Windows DLL cross-compiled from this crate by crates/gog/build.rs and embedded in decanter; it runs inside the Wine/Proton prefix of a GOG game, as the game's own Galaxy64.dll.

components.name: GalaxyCommunication stand-in service
components.provenance: crates/galaxy-service/Cargo.toml. A dependency-free Windows executable cross-compiled from this crate by crates/gog/build.rs and embedded in decanter; it is registered as the GalaxyCommunication service in the Wine/Proton prefix of a game that uses the Galaxy SDK. Written for this repository; it holds none of the code of GOG's or comet's dummy service.

components.name: Report server
components.provenance: crates/reports-server/LICENSE. A separate binary with its own Cargo workspace and Cargo.lock. It links the s3db storage engine (AGPL-3.0-or-later, https://git.yerasuu.com/yerasuu/s3db, pinned by tag) and decanter-report (GPL-3.0-or-later). Not part of the decanter application or its releases.

components.name: Inter font
components.provenance: Copyright 2016 The Inter Project Authors; static TTFs of Inter 4.1 from the upstream release (rsms/inter, extras/ttf; app/assets/fonts/README). Bundled in the binary; keep the copyright and license notices.

components.name: JetBrains Mono fonts
components.provenance: Copyright 2020 The JetBrains Mono Project Authors (https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono); version 2.304 from nixpkgs. Bundled in the binary; keep the notices.

components.name: Oswald font
components.provenance: Copyright 2016 The Oswald Project Authors (https://github.com/googlefonts/OswaldFont); variable font, google-fonts 2026-03-13, from nixpkgs. Bundled in the binary; keep the notices.

components.name: Twemoji bitmaps
components.provenance: Twemoji graphics, Copyright Twitter, Inc and other contributors (app/assets/emoji/README), extracted from SteamOS's twemoji.ttf. Attribution is required: it is given in LICENSES.md and in the notices that travel with every package; the application has no About screen yet.

components.name: decanter artwork
components.provenance: The application's own logo and icon. The owner has not recorded a separate licence for the artwork: GPL-3.0-or-later is assumed until they decide.

components.name: Rust dependencies of the decanter workspace
components.provenance: python3 scripts/licenses.py inventory. Mostly MIT or Apache-2.0 (often both), with Unicode-3.0, BSD, ISC, Zlib and CC0; three MPL-2.0 crates (cbindgen, dwrote, option-ext) used unmodified. prost, prost-derive, prost-types and prost-build are Apache-2.0; protox, protox-parse and prost-reflect MIT OR Apache-2.0; their helpers logos (and -codegen, -derive), petgraph, fixedbitset, hashbrown, multimap, prettyplease, beef, unicode-width are MIT OR Apache-2.0, miette and miette-derive Apache-2.0, foldhash Zlib; sha2 and getrandom MIT OR Apache-2.0 (crates/galaxy, kb #1532, #1533). The gog crate is no longer a dependency: it is the api module of decanter-gog (crates/gog/src/api), listed as its own component.

components.name: Rust dependencies of the report server
components.provenance: python3 scripts/licenses.py inventory (cargo metadata inside crates/reports-server); s3db and its s3db-crypto and s3db-macros crates are AGPL-3.0-or-later.

components.name: psport and the PS4 ports
components.provenance: Built from https://github.com/yerasuu/psport at run time (GPL-2.0-only) and run as a separate process; decanter only starts it and reads its logs. AnyPS5, when used, is likewise a separate work under its own licence.

components.name: Raven
components.provenance: Built from https://github.com/mirkobrombin/raven at run time (GPL-3.0-or-later; crates/runtime/src/runner.rs RAVEN_COMMIT) after the user confirms it, and run as a separate process; decanter only starts it and keeps its build log.

components.name: Bloodborne patch definitions
components.provenance: The community's Bloodborne patch definitions, moved here from psport's patches/Bloodborne.xml (kb #1387, decision #1388) so decanter ships them and hands them to the port as its built-in patch file. The Author attributes name Kyo, auser1337, Lance McDonald (manfightdragon), illusion, emoose, Dasaav, Foxy Hooligans, Imedved, Whitehawkx, bloo, stagvant, yogesh1239 and bbport; the file is unchanged.

components.name: Galaxy protocol definitions
components.provenance: Four .proto files of https://github.com/Yepoleb/gog_protocols at commit 923e8a0008603365d29002db611559190da5bf99 (gog.protocols.pb, galaxy.protocols.communication_service, galaxy.protocols.webbroker_service, galaxy.common.protocols.connection), copied verbatim with that repository's LICENSE (CC0 1.0 Universal); reverse-engineered by their authors, not GOG's. crates/galaxy/build.rs generates Rust from them at build time with protox and prost-build (kb #1532).
